research_question: Does weighted sharing improve treated effluent daily volume prediction?
planned_comparison: Main K30 B30 h1 and h3 weighted residual plus bias vs Persistence
success_evidence: Positive equal SiteID MAE skill with multiplicity-adjusted interval and all dates availability disclosed
failure_or_limit: Intervals crossing zero or materially heterogeneous deterioration do not establish stable benefit

research_question: Does source similarity assignment add benefit beyond matched uniform sharing?
planned_comparison: Main K30 B30 h1 and h3 weighted residual plus bias vs matched uniform residual plus bias
success_evidence: Positive paired skill under same tuning and information budget
failure_or_limit: eta0 or indistinguishable uniform performance does not support similarity weighting

research_question: Is weight assignment rather than concentration helpful?
planned_comparison: Main K30 B30 h1 and h3 weighted vs three fixed shuffled weight assignments
success_evidence: Matched settings and bias estimation show consistent exploratory advantage
failure_or_limit: Similar shuffled performance fails to support assignment mechanism; three seeds not a permutation test

research_question: Does short-history sharing approach longer-history local forecasting?
planned_comparison: Shared B30 vs local B90/B180 and shared B90 vs local B180
success_evidence: Paired absolute MAE and ratio evidence plus Persistence context
failure_or_limit: No prespecified engineering margin means no equivalence or noninferiority/history-saving claim

research_question: Can forecast-time features identify higher-error predictions before truth arrives?
planned_comparison: Group-cross-fitted source risk and fixed10/20pct source thresholds; target risk vs random/missingness/disagreement rules
success_evidence: Macro and within SiteID-window discrimination plus useful precision/miss rate/retained MAE and actual review burden
failure_or_limit: Between-site discrimination alone does not establish within-facility daily warning; fitted training scores cannot prove validity

research_question: Can results generalize across independent physical wastewater facilities?
planned_comparison: No final or protected performance in this stage
success_evidence: Requires historical physical grouping and independent validation
failure_or_limit: Names and software group keys cannot verify physical independence
